info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel Management API provides access to specific channel information within the banking domain, allowing users to retrieve details based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is designed to support contact center operators and banking personnel in managing customer interactions effectively. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate channel-specific data into customer support solutions, enhancing service delivery and operational efficiency. Typical use cases include fetching channel configurations, support resources, or operational metrics for targeted banking services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the specific details of the contact center management associated with the resource ID 'RES-100045'. Use this operation to access comprehensive information that can assist in managing and assessing the performance of your contact center.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data related to a specific Contact Center Management resource identified by the provided RES-100045 ID. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the request to obtain the required information.
